detail: Designer Hassa Architecture documents the 2011–2012 design, six surrounding half-dome roofs, hexagonal central layout and six piers.
The construction materials supplier identifies the West Ataşehir mosque client and reinforced concrete construction project.
In the contemporaneous opening account, minister Erdoğan Bayraktar describes the 42 m dome, 27 m span, four 72 m triple-balconied minarets and reinforced-concrete structure.
Contemporary Anadolu Agency report records the opening of the mosque and park on July 20, 2012.
